description: The screens and states both apps must keep looking alike (AGENTS.md, Code and tests). Each app's shot test (Android UiShotsTest, iOS UIShotsTests) captures every entry by id on the demo account, and scripts/ui-compare.py puts the two side by side with these notes: expect is what both should show, differences what may differ and why, pending a decided change not made yet, open a difference seen but not decided. An entry with a capture reason can't be reached on the demo account and is listed only.

setups.default: Portrait, the phone's default text size.
setups.landscape: Landscape, the phone's default text size.
setups.large: Portrait, large text: Android font scale 1.3, iOS Extra Extra Extra Large (about 1.35), the largest size short of the accessibility sizes.

states.title: Sign in
states.expect: Email and password, Sign in, Forgot password and Create one, then Try the demo under a rule. No map behind it.

states.title: Tracks, sheet closed
states.expect: The map, with the mode toggle (Normal, Fog) at the top left and the rail (Layers, Places, Find my location, Export) at the top right. The closed sheet shows its grip and the summary line: tracks, distance, time. A white bottom bar with a thin line above it.

states.title: Tracks, sheet half open
states.expect: The summary line, the master checkbox with its ▾, the Type and Dates chips and the distance chip ("Any distance" or the band picked, in whole units, "2 – 21 mi"), the visible area's rows with their round-ended Trip badges, and the checked count at the bottom.

differences.what: Filter chips are capsules on iOS and rounded squares on Android.

states.title: Tracks, sheet open all the way
states.expect: The sheet up to the status bar, over the mode toggle and the rail, with the list's rows below the chips.

states.title: A track focused
states.expect: A row tapped: the toolbar takes the summary's place, its buttons spread across it: Hide (the crossed eye), Info, Edit (dimmed for the demo), Add to trip, ⋯ and Zoom in the accent. The sheet stays at half, the list under the toolbar. The mode toggle and the rail stay. The map draws the track in pace bands, above the sheet.

states.title: A track's Info
states.expect: Info tapped on the focused track: a sheet titled Info with the server's lines (Type, Start, End, Distance, Moving time, Elapsed time, Pace or Speed, Elevation gain), the pace bands' legend from Slower to Faster, and the note on what moving time leaves out.

differences.what: A bottom sheet with a drag handle and no ✕ on Android, a page sheet with a grabber and Close on iOS.
differences.why: Each platform's way out of a sheet: Android has Back, a swipe down and a tap on the map; iOS has no Back.

states.title: A track checked
states.expect: The focused row's tile tapped: the toolbar stays, the master checkbox is ticked, and the bottom line counts one checked. The mode toggle and the rail stay.

states.title: Fog of War
states.expect: Fog's coverage over the map, with no sheet: the sheet is Normal mode's. The Fog button names the level in view.

states.title: Fog's level menu
states.expect: A tap on the Fog button while Fog is on: each level with its count, the one in view marked.

states.title: Layers menu
states.expect: Show layers, Satellite where the style offers it, Roads, and the bike, shared and mountain-bike paths.

states.title: Places menu
states.expect: Show places and each Spot category, all off at first.

states.title: Export viewfinder
states.expect: The window over the map, the size presets and Custom, the stats card switch, and Export.

differences.what: iOS saves the image to Photos and offers the share sheet; Android saves to Pictures/HoldMyTrack and offers its share sheet.

states.title: Trips, sheet closed
states.expect: The map in Normal with the open Trip's tracks and photos. The closed sheet shows only its grip.

states.title: Trips, sheet half open
states.expect: The newest Trip open: its folder (name, Edit, Send, Delete), the description, the Trip's totals with each type's share, then its rows with × set in under the folder.

states.title: Trips, sheet open all the way
states.expect: As half open, with more rows, and the other Trips' folders below the open one.

states.title: Trips, the open Trip folded
states.expect: The open Trip's folder tapped: its description, totals and rows fold away; the Trip stays open on the map.

states.title: Library, sheet closed
states.expect: The map with every track. The closed sheet shows only its grip.

states.title: Library, sheet half open
states.expect: Search and + at the top, the sort and the Type, Dates, distance ("Any distance" or the band picked, in whole units, "2 – 21 mi") and Trip chips, the count, then the page's rows.

differences.what: Chips are capsules on iOS and rounded squares on Android.

states.title: Library, sheet open all the way
states.expect: As half open, up to the status bar.

states.title: Sync, sheet closed
states.expect: Opened from Library's +. The closed sheet shows only its grip.

states.title: Sync, sheet half open
states.expect: Upload at the head (none for the demo), the demo's read-only notice, and "Nothing waiting" with no recordings on the phone.

differences.what: iOS has "‹ Library" at the top; Android goes back with the system Back.
Android's empty note names Health Connect sessions; iOS's names only recordings.
differences.why: iOS has no health source yet (HealthKit is planned).

states.title: Sync, sheet open all the way
states.expect: As half open, up to the status bar.

states.title: You
states.expect: The account card (initials, name, country, timezone, units, the four stats and the recent weeks' grid, Track graph & trends), Privacy, App (Theme, Language, Take a tour), HoldMyTrack (About, Help, Contacts), the version, Sign out.

differences.what: Theme is a segmented control on iOS and a toggle button group on Android.
Language opens the app's page in iOS Settings; Android picks it in the app.
differences.why: iOS keeps an app's language in its Settings page.

states.title: Privacy
states.expect: The Private locations, read-only for the demo, and the Privacy policy link; no Download your data for the demo.

states.title: Settings
states.expect: The web's Settings page in the app, read-only for the demo.

differences.what: The avatar's picker is iOS's photo picker, camera or Files on iOS, and Android's photo picker on Android.

states.title: Tracks, landscape
states.expect: The sheet half open beside the map's controls; at least its chips and the first row in view.

states.title: Trips, landscape
states.expect: The open Trip's folder and what fits under it.

states.title: Library, landscape
states.expect: Library's head and chips, and what rows fit.

states.title: You, landscape
states.expect: The You page, clear of the camera cutout and the home indicator.

states.title: Tracks, large text
states.expect: Rows grow and wrap; badges stay on one line; nothing breaks mid-word.

states.title: Trips, large text
states.expect: The folder's name wraps between words; the totals' types and shares stay in two columns or stack.

states.title: Library, large text
states.expect: Chips keep their labels or scroll sideways; rows grow.

states.title: You, large text
states.expect: The four stats stack two by two once they don't fit, as Android's do; no label breaks mid-word.

states.title: Edit window
states.capture: The demo account has no Edit window.

states.title: Edit window's Photos tab
states.capture: The demo account has no Edit window.

states.title: Route editor
states.capture: The demo account can't edit a route.

states.title: Upload
states.capture: The demo account has no Upload.

states.title: Recording
states.capture: Needs a moving location; the demo's recording never reaches the server.

states.title: A Spot's popup
states.capture: Needs a Spot in view at zoom 13 or more.

states.title: Update screen
states.capture: Needs the server to refuse the build.
